field.label: Send order notifications
field.comment: Notifications follow the eight sales emails and inherit their "Notify Customer" setting: if the email is not sent to the customer, neither is the push. Store-view scope, so one market can pilot the app.

group.label: Firebase Cloud Messaging
group.comment:
Default scope only: a Firebase project belongs to an app, not to a store view.

Filling this in does not switch the transport on. The shipped binding is a log sink, so the whole chain is observable before any credentials exist; point Scr1be\PushNotifications\Api\PushTransportInterface at Scr1be\PushNotifications\Model\Fcm\FcmTransport in your project's di.xml when you are ready.

field.label: Service account key (JSON)
field.comment: The whole JSON key file from the Firebase console, pasted. Stored encrypted with the installation's crypt key. Only `project_id`, `client_email` and `private_key` are read.
